<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Feline Dance](/Feats.aspx?ID=5445) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Fortune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=612" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 69

**Archetype** [Clawdancer](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=221)

**Frequency**
once per hour

**Prerequisites**
[Clawdancer Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5436)

**Access**
 catfolk  ancestry

**Trigger**
You attempt a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save.

**Requirements**
You’re in either claw stance or talon stance.

</column>

---

You fluidly move between stances in the process of dodging. Roll the save twice and take the higher result. If you were in claw stance, you shift to talon stance, and vice versa.
name: Feline Dance
requirement: You’re in either claw stance or talon stance.
requirement_markdown: You’re in either claw stance or talon stance.
